# EuroPrint ERP — Full Item-Level Master Plan (2026-07-11)

This was a strictly read-only pass; the only artifact produced is this file. No code, schema,
or data was touched.

## What this document is

An item-level (not module-summary) reference walking through every distinct vision decision
found in `docs/vision/FULL-VISION-EXTRACTION-2026-07-07.md` (QISM A — 1,000 core decisions,
50 per module × 20 modules — plus QISM C — the "[B/TASDIQ]" per-module extension tables), one
entry per source row, each independently re-verified against live code and the local
`europrint` database this pass (not copied from any prior audit). QISM B (four cross-cutting
interviews) and QISM D (a smaller supplementary 629-row spot-check) are intentionally out of
scope here — the source document's own "per-module" organization is QISM A + C only.

Produced by 30 read-only agents (one per module, or two for the ten largest modules), plus a
follow-up reconciliation pass for 75 rows two split agents both happened to cover (see back-matter).

No file in this repository other than this one was created, edited, or deleted to produce it.

For the high-level, module-summary view (percent-complete per module, buildable-maximum vs
true-100% ceilings) instead of this row-by-row view: no separate tracked document exists for
that in this repo as of this writing — the module-summary table referenced when this task was
requested was pasted directly into the requesting chat session, not saved as a file.

However `employees` has a single `position_id` FK (verified via `resolveByPosition` query joining `employees e INNER JOIN positions p ON p.id = e.position_id`), so the literal "bitta xodim ikki karta egallasa" (one employee holding two cards) scenario has no explicit disambiguation test/log in code.
- **If Qisman:** Works — role-card-driven resolution inherently avoids the ambiguity for the common case. Doesn't work / unverified — no explicit multi-card-per-employee test path or logged decision exists.

**Note on totals vs the original ~2,167 estimate:** the actual row count found by walking QISM A
+ QISM C directly is 2563, higher than the ~2,167 the requesting session's own
coverage-audit table estimated for several modules (04/Coordination, 05/Director, 11/MM,
15/Kanban, 16/IoT, 19/POS, 20/CC in particular) — live inspection of the source document found
those modules' QISM C tables genuinely contain more distinct rows than that summary implied.
This document reflects what was actually found in the source table this pass, not a forced
match to the earlier estimate.

**Note on the 75-row reconciliation:** the sharding instructions given to the 10 split-module
agent-pairs left the exact QISM-C midpoint imprecise by design (agents were told the boundary
"doesn't need to be precise"). In practice this caused two modules — 03/Finance (50 rows) and
08/MES (25 rows) — to have both split agents independently cover the same rows, twice, at
their internal QISM-C numbering boundary. In several of those 75 cases the two independent
live-verification passes reached a genuinely different Ha/Qisman/Yo'q conclusion for the same
row. A dedicated follow-up reconciliation pass re-examined every one of the 75, resolved
disagreements with a fresh tie-breaking check where cheaply possible, and produced exactly one
final entry per row (folded into the module 03 and 08 sections above, not called out separately)
— counted once each in this document, not twice.
